name: upstream/arbitrary-variant-validity
description: Ported from vendor/tailwindcss-v3/tests/arbitrary-variants.test.js, `test('variants without & or an at-rule are ignored')`. Per `isValidVariantFormatString` in setupContextUtils.js, an arbitrary variant whose format lacks `&` and doesn't start with `@` is dropped. The expected oracle output for these candidates is empty. Substituted `underline` for `flex` (we don't have value-bearing utilities yet).
